主要内容: On February 8, 2013, Insperity, Inc. issued a press release announcing its financial and operating results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2012. The press release was included as Exhibit 99.1 in the Form 8-K filing. The report detailed the company's performance for the specified periods, providing insights into its financial condition and operational outcomes. The filing was signed by Daniel D. Herink, Senior Vice President of Legal, General Counsel, and Secretary, on behalf of Insperity, Inc. The press release is available as an exhibit to the report, offering detailed information on the company's financial and operational results for the referenced periods.
